margarita.title: Classic Margarita
margarita.description: Tequila, lime and orange liqueur, shaken and served with a salted rim.
steps: Rub the rim of a rocks glass with lime and dip in salt.
Shake the tequila, orange liqueur, lime and agave with ice.
Strain into the glass over fresh ice.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Shake lime juice, orange juice and agave with ice and top with sparkling water.

margarita.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

moscow-mule.title: Moscow Mule
moscow-mule.description: Vodka, lime and spicy ginger beer, served in a copper mug.
steps: Fill a copper mug with ice.
Add the vodka and lime juice and top with ginger beer.
Stir gently.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Use extra lime and ginger beer and skip the vodka.

moscow-mule.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

cosmopolitan.title: Cosmopolitan
cosmopolitan.description: Citrus vodka, orange liqueur, cranberry and lime, shaken and served up.
steps: Shake everything with ice until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe or martini glass.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Shake cranberry, lime and orange juice with a splash of soda.

cosmopolitan.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

manhattan.title: Manhattan
manhattan.description: Rye whiskey and sweet vermouth with bitters, stirred and served up.
steps: Stir everything with ice for 20 to 30 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
manhattan.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

gin-and-tonic.title: Gin and Tonic
gin-and-tonic.description: Gin topped with tonic water over plenty of ice.
steps: Fill a highball or balloon glass with ice.
Add the gin and top with tonic.
Squeeze in the lime and stir gently.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Use a non-alcoholic gin alternative or just tonic with lime and cucumber.

gin-and-tonic.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

paloma.title: Paloma
paloma.description: Tequila with grapefruit soda and lime, Mexico's favorite highball.
steps: Rim a highball glass with salt if you like and fill with ice.
Add the tequila and lime and top with grapefruit soda.
Stir gently.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Grapefruit soda with lime and a pinch of salt.

paloma.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

negroni.title: Negroni
negroni.description: Equal parts gin, Campari and sweet vermouth, stirred over ice.
steps: Stir everything with ice.
Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Use non-alcoholic bitter aperitivo and alcohol-free vermouth.

negroni.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

french-75.title: French 75
french-75.description: Gin, lemon and sugar shaken and topped with Champagne.
steps: Shake the gin, lemon and syrup with ice.
Strain into a flute and top with Champagne.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Top lemon and syrup with sparkling grape juice or alcohol-free sparkling wine.

french-75.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

long-island-iced-tea.title: Long Island Iced Tea
long-island-iced-tea.description: Five white spirits with lemon and a splash of cola. Strong despite the name.
steps: Shake everything except the cola with ice.
Strain into an ice-filled highball and top with cola.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Iced black tea with lemon, a little syrup and a splash of cola.

long-island-iced-tea.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

tequila-sunrise.title: Tequila Sunrise
tequila-sunrise.description: Tequila and orange juice with grenadine sinking to make a sunrise.
steps: Fill a highball with ice and add the tequila and orange juice. Stir.
Slowly pour the grenadine down the side so it sinks.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Orange juice with grenadine poured in to sink.

tequila-sunrise.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

bloody-mary.title: Bloody Mary
bloody-mary.description: Vodka in spiced tomato juice with horseradish, Worcestershire and celery.

ingredients.item: pinch of celery salt and black pepper

steps: Roll everything gently between two shakers with ice, or stir in a pint glass.
Strain into an ice-filled glass with a celery salt rim if you like.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Leave out the vodka for a Virgin Mary.

tom-collins.title: Tom Collins
tom-collins.description: Gin, lemon and sugar, lengthened with soda water.
steps: Shake the gin, lemon and syrup with ice.
Strain into an ice-filled Collins glass and top with soda.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Lemon, syrup and soda water make fresh lemonade soda.

tom-collins.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

dark-n-stormy.title: Dark 'n' Stormy
dark-n-stormy.description: Dark rum floated over spicy ginger beer and lime.
steps: Fill a highball with ice and add the ginger beer and lime.
Float the rum on top.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Ginger beer with lime.

dark-n-stormy.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

mimosa.title: Mimosa
mimosa.description: Chilled sparkling wine with orange juice.
steps: Pour the sparkling wine into a flute.
Top gently with the orange juice.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Orange juice with sparkling water or alcohol-free sparkling wine.

mimosa.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

aperol-spritz.title: Aperol Spritz
aperol-spritz.description: Aperol, prosecco and soda over ice.
steps: Fill a wine glass with ice.
Add the prosecco, then the Aperol and a splash of soda. Stir gently.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Use a non-alcoholic orange aperitivo with alcohol-free sparkling wine.

aperol-spritz.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

whiskey-sour.title: Whiskey Sour
whiskey-sour.description: Bourbon, lemon and sugar with a silky egg-white foam.
steps: Shake the bourbon, lemon, syrup and egg white without ice for 15 seconds.
Add ice and shake hard again.
Strain into a rocks glass over ice and dot the foam with bitters.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Shake lemon, syrup, egg white and cold black tea for a sour mocktail.

whiskey-sour.note: Uses raw egg white; leave it out or use pasteurized whites if you prefer.

espresso-martini.title: Espresso Martini
espresso-martini.description: Vodka, coffee liqueur and fresh espresso shaken to a creamy foam.
steps: Shake everything hard with ice for 15 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Shake espresso, syrup and a splash of cream hard with ice.

espresso-martini.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

mai-tai.title: Mai Tai
mai-tai.description: Aged rum with lime, orange curaçao and almond orgeat, the tiki classic.
steps: Shake everything with crushed ice.
Pour unstrained into a double rocks glass and top with more crushed ice.

cocktail.garnish: spent lime shell and mint sprig
cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Shake lime, orange juice, orgeat and pineapple juice with crushed ice.

mai-tai.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

daiquiri.title: Classic Daiquiri
daiquiri.description: White rum, lime and sugar, shaken and served up.
steps: Shake everything hard with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Shake lime and syrup with ice and top with soda.

daiquiri.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

martini.title: Dry Gin Martini
martini.description: Gin and dry vermouth, stirred ice cold.
steps: Stir with ice for 30 seconds until very cold.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
martini.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

mojito.title: Mojito
mojito.description: White rum muddled with mint, lime and sugar and topped with soda.
steps: Gently muddle the mint with the syrup and lime in a highball.
Add the rum, fill with crushed ice and stir.
Top with soda.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Leave out the rum and add more soda for a virgin mojito.

mojito.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

old-fashioned.title: Old Fashioned
old-fashioned.description: Bourbon or rye stirred with sugar and bitters.
steps: Stir everything with ice until chilled.
Strain over a large ice cube in a rocks glass.
Express an orange peel over the drink.
old-fashioned.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

pina-colada.title: Piña Colada
pina-colada.description: Rum blended with pineapple and cream of coconut.
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Pour into a hurricane glass.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Blend without the rum for a virgin piña colada.

pina-colada.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

pho.title: Beef Pho
pho.description: Vietnamese rice noodle soup in a clear, spiced beef broth, topped with thin slices of beef and fresh herbs.

ingredients.item: Thai basil, cilantro and sliced green onion

steps: Cover the bones with water, boil for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse to keep the broth clear.
Char the onion and ginger in a dry pan or under the broiler until blackened in spots.
Toast the star anise, cinnamon, cloves and coriander in a dry pan for 2 minutes.
Put the bones, brisket, onion, ginger and spices in a large pot with 4 quarts of water and simmer gently for 3 hours, skimming as needed. Lift out the brisket after 1 1/2 hours and slice it.
Strain the broth and season with fish sauce and sugar.
Cook the noodles as the package directs and divide among bowls. Top with brisket and raw sirloin, then ladle the boiling broth over to cook the sirloin.
Serve with bean sprouts, herbs and lime wedges.
pho.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

fish-and-chips.title: Fish and Chips
fish-and-chips.description: Crisp beer-battered white fish with thick-cut fries, British style.

ingredients.item: russet potatoes, cut into thick fries
cod or haddock fillets, cut into 4 pieces
all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting
malt vinegar, lemon wedges and tartar sauce, to serve

steps: Soak the cut potatoes in cold water for 15 minutes, then drain and pat very dry.
Heat oil to 325°F and fry the potatoes for 5 to 6 minutes until soft but pale. Drain.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt, then whisk in the cold beer until just smooth.
Raise the oil to 375°F. Pat the fish dry, dust with flour, dip in the batter and fry for 5 to 7 minutes until deep golden. Drain on a rack.
Fry the potatoes again for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp. Salt well.
Serve with malt vinegar, lemon and tartar sauce.
fish-and-chips.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

carrot-cake.title: Carrot Cake
carrot-cake.description: Moist spiced carrot layer cake with walnuts and cream cheese frosting.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease two 9-inch cake pans.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.
Beat the eggs, oil and both sugars, then stir in the dry ingredients, carrots and walnuts.
Divide between the pans and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely.
Beat the cream cheese and butter, then beat in the powdered sugar and vanilla until fluffy.
Fill and frost the cooled cake.
carrot-cake.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

samosas.title: Vegetable Samosas
samosas.description: Crisp, flaky pastries filled with spiced potatoes and peas, from India.

ingredients.item: vegetable oil, plus more for frying

steps: Mix the flour, carom seeds and a pinch of salt, rub in the 1/4 cup oil, then add water a little at a time to make a stiff dough. Cover and rest 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, fry the cumin seeds, then add the chile and ginger. Add the potatoes, peas, spices and salt, cook 3 minutes and stir in the cilantro. Cool.
Divide the dough into 6 balls, roll each into an oval and cut in half.
Form each half into a cone, sealing the seam with water, fill with potato mixture and pinch the top closed.
Fry in oil at 325°F for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp. Serve with mint or tamarind chutney.
samosas.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chana-masala.title: Chana Masala
chana-masala.description: Chickpeas simmered in a tangy, spiced tomato and onion gravy, a North Indian favorite.
steps: Heat the oil and fry the cumin seeds until they sizzle.
Add the onion and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until golden. Add the ginger, garlic and chile and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes and the ground spices and cook until the oil starts to separate, about 8 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and 1 cup water, then simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Stir in the garam masala and lemon juice, season with salt and top with cilantro. Serve with rice or naan.
chana-masala.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

ramen.title: Chicken Ramen
ramen.description: Quick home ramen in a savory soy chicken broth with noodles, a soft egg and toppings.
steps: Simmer the broth with the garlic and ginger for 15 minutes. Remove the aromatics and stir in the soy sauce, mirin and sesame oil.
Poach the chicken in the broth for 12 to 15 minutes until cooked, then slice.
Boil the eggs for 6 1/2 minutes, cool in ice water, peel and halve.
Cook the noodles as the package directs and drain.
Divide the noodles and spinach among bowls and pour the hot broth over. Top with chicken, egg, green onion and nori.
ramen.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

orange-chicken.title: Orange Chicken
orange-chicken.description: Crispy chicken pieces tossed in a sticky, sweet and tangy orange sauce.

ingredients.item: boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: Toss the chicken in the egg, then in the cornstarch and flour mixed together.
Fry in oil at 350°F in batches for 5 to 6 minutes until crisp and cooked. Drain.
Simmer the orange juice, zest, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until glossy and thick.
Toss the chicken in the sauce and serve with rice and sliced green onion.
orange-chicken.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

oatmeal.title: Oatmeal with Fruit
oatmeal.description: Creamy stovetop oats topped with fresh fruit, a drizzle of honey and a pinch of cinnamon.
steps: Bring the milk, water and salt to a simmer.
Stir in the oats and cook over medium-low heat for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring often, until creamy.
Stir in the cinnamon and let stand 1 minute.
Spoon into bowls and top with fruit and honey.
oatmeal.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

dumplings.title: Pan-Fried Pork Dumplings
dumplings.description: Juicy pork and cabbage dumplings with crisp, golden bottoms, served with a soy dipping sauce.

ingredients.item: soy sauce and 1 tbsp rice vinegar, for dipping

steps: Salt the cabbage, let stand 10 minutes, then squeeze out the water.
Mix the pork, cabbage, green onions, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil and wine.
Place a teaspoon of filling on each wrapper, wet the edge, fold in half and pleat to seal.
Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet, add dumplings flat side down and fry 2 minutes until golden.
Add 1/2 cup water, cover and steam 6 to 8 minutes until the water is gone and the filling is cooked.
Serve with the soy and vinegar dipping sauce.
dumplings.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

kung-pao-chicken.title: Kung Pao Chicken
kung-pao-chicken.description: Sichuan stir-fry of chicken, peanuts and dried chiles in a glossy, tingly, sweet-sour sauce.
steps: Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 2 tsp cornstarch.
Stir together the 2 tbsp soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, 1 tsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water.
Heat the oil in a wok, fry the chiles and peppercorns for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the chicken and stir-fry 4 to 5 minutes until cooked. Add the garlic, ginger and green onions for 1 minute.
Pour in the sauce, toss until glossy and stir in the peanuts. Serve with rice.
kung-pao-chicken.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

biryani.title: Chicken Biryani
biryani.description: Fragrant layered rice and spiced chicken, finished with saffron, fried onions and fresh herbs.

ingredients.item: saffron soaked in 3 tbsp warm milk

steps: Marinate the chicken in the yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, spices and 1 tsp salt for at least 30 minutes.
Fry the onions in the ghee until deep golden. Set half aside.
Add the chicken to the pot with the remaining onions and cook 15 minutes until almost done.
Boil the rice in salted water with the cardamom and bay leaf for 5 minutes, until 70 percent cooked, then drain.
Layer the rice over the chicken, top with the reserved onions, herbs and saffron milk.
Cover tightly and cook on very low heat for 25 minutes. Gently mix before serving.
biryani.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

grilled-salmon.title: Grilled Salmon with Asparagus
grilled-salmon.description: Lemon-garlic salmon fillets grilled with tender asparagus.
steps: Heat the grill to medium-high and oil the grates.
Mix the oil, garlic, lemon zest, salt and pepper. Brush over the salmon and asparagus.
Grill the salmon skin side down for 6 to 8 minutes, flip and cook 2 to 3 minutes more until it flakes.
Grill the asparagus for 5 to 6 minutes, turning, until tender and lightly charred.
Drizzle with lemon juice and scatter with herbs.
grilled-salmon.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

spring-rolls.title: Fried Spring Rolls
spring-rolls.description: Crisp rolls filled with cabbage, carrot, mushrooms and glass noodles, with sweet chili sauce.
steps: Stir-fry the garlic, cabbage, carrot and mushrooms for 3 minutes. Add the noodles, green onions, soy sauce and sugar. Cool completely.
Place 2 tbsp filling near one corner of a wrapper, fold the corner over, fold in the sides and roll up, sealing with the flour paste.
Fry at 350°F for 3 to 4 minutes until golden and crisp. Drain.
Serve hot with sweet chili sauce.
spring-rolls.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chicken-fajitas.title: Chicken Fajitas
chicken-fajitas.description: Sizzling strips of spiced chicken with peppers and onions, wrapped in warm tortillas.

ingredients.item: boneless chicken breasts, sliced into strips
salsa, guacamole and sour cream, to serve

steps: Toss the chicken with half the oil, the spices, salt and lime juice.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat and cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes until charred and cooked. Remove.
Add the remaining oil, peppers and onion and cook 5 minutes until tender and charred.
Return the chicken to the pan and toss together.
Serve in warm tortillas with salsa, guacamole and sour cream.
chicken-fajitas.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

butter-chicken.title: Butter Chicken
butter-chicken.description: Tender chicken in a mild, silky tomato sauce enriched with butter and cream.

ingredients.item: boneless chicken thighs, cut into pieces

steps: Marinate the chicken in the yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp garam masala and the chile powder for 30 minutes.
Sear the chicken in 1 tbsp butter until browned. Set aside.
Melt the remaining butter and cook the onion until soft. Add the tomato puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Blend the sauce smooth if you like, then add the chicken and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the cream, remaining garam masala, crushed fenugreek, sugar and salt. Top with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.
butter-chicken.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chicken-teriyaki.title: Chicken Teriyaki
chicken-teriyaki.description: Pan-seared chicken thighs glazed in a glossy homemade teriyaki sauce.
steps: Stir together the soy sauce, mirin, sake, brown sugar and ginger.
Heat the oil and cook the chicken skin side down for 6 to 7 minutes until crisp, then flip and cook 4 minutes.
Pour off the fat, add the sauce and simmer, turning the chicken, until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Slice and serve over rice, topped with sesame seeds and green onions.
chicken-teriyaki.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

fish-tacos.title: Baja Fish Tacos
fish-tacos.description: Crispy battered fish in corn tortillas with cabbage slaw and creamy lime sauce.

ingredients.item: cod or other white fish, cut into strips

steps: Mix the mayonnaise, sour cream and half the lime juice for the sauce.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and beer into a smooth batter.
Dip the fish in the batter and fry at 375°F for 3 to 4 minutes until golden. Drain.
Toss the cabbage with the remaining lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Fill the tortillas with fish, cabbage, sauce, pico de gallo and cilantro.
fish-tacos.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

crab-cakes.title: Maryland Crab Cakes
crab-cakes.description: Golden, lightly bound lump crab cakes seasoned with Old Bay.
steps: Whisk the egg, mayonnaise, mustard, Worcestershire and Old Bay.
Gently fold in the crab, crackers and parsley without breaking up the lumps.
Shape into 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes.
Fry in butter over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with lemon and tartar sauce.
crab-cakes.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

shrimp-and-grits.title: Shrimp and Grits
shrimp-and-grits.description: Southern creamy cheese grits topped with shrimp in a bacon, garlic and lemon pan sauce.
steps: Bring the milk, water and a pinch of salt to a boil, whisk in the grits and simmer 20 to 25 minutes, stirring often.
Stir the cheese and butter into the grits.
Cook the bacon until crisp, then remove, leaving the fat.
Season the shrimp with Cajun seasoning and cook in the bacon fat 2 minutes per side with the garlic.
Add the lemon juice and bacon, spoon over the grits and top with green onions.
shrimp-and-grits.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

lo-mein.title: Chicken Lo Mein
lo-mein.description: Soft egg noodles stir-fried with chicken and vegetables in a savory soy sauce.
steps: Cook the noodles as the package directs, drain and rinse.
Mix the soy sauces, oyster sauce, sugar and sesame oil.
Stir-fry the chicken in hot oil until cooked, then add the garlic, cabbage and carrot for 2 minutes.
Add the noodles, sauce and green onions and toss for 2 minutes until coated and hot.
lo-mein.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chocolate-cake.title: Chocolate Layer Cake
chocolate-cake.description: Rich, moist chocolate cake with fudgy chocolate buttercream.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease two 9-inch pans.
Whisk the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder and salt.
Beat in the eggs, buttermilk and oil, then stir in the hot coffee. The batter will be thin.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes and cool completely.
Beat the butter, powdered sugar, cocoa, milk and vanilla until fluffy. Fill and frost the cake.
chocolate-cake.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chicken-tikka-masala.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
chicken-tikka-masala.description: Charred, yogurt-marinated chicken in a creamy, spiced tomato masala.
steps: Marinate the chicken in the yogurt, lemon juice and half the spices for at least 1 hour.
Broil or grill the chicken until charred at the edges, about 10 minutes.
Cook the onion in oil until golden, add the garlic, ginger and remaining spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes, then stir in the cream.
Add the chicken, simmer 5 minutes, season with salt and top with cilantro.
chicken-tikka-masala.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chicken-quesadilla.title: Chicken Quesadilla
chicken-quesadilla.description: Crisp flour tortillas filled with melted cheese, shredded chicken and peppers.

ingredients.item: salsa and sour cream, to serve

steps: Toss the chicken with the chili powder.
Scatter cheese, chicken, pepper and green onions over half of each tortilla and fold over.
Cook in a buttered skillet over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.
chicken-quesadilla.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chicken-enchiladas.title: Chicken Enchiladas
chicken-enchiladas.description: Corn tortillas rolled around chicken and cheese, baked in red enchilada sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Mix the chicken, 1 1/2 cups cheese, sour cream and cumin.
Warm the tortillas so they bend, fill each with chicken and roll up.
Spread a little sauce in a baking dish, add the enchiladas seam side down and pour over the rest of the sauce. Top with the remaining cheese.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling. Top with cilantro, green onions and avocado.
chicken-enchiladas.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chocolate-chip-cookies.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
chocolate-chip-cookies.description: Chewy, golden cookies with crisp edges and plenty of chocolate chips.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt.
Beat the butter and sugars until creamy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the dry ingredients, then the chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto baking sheets and bake 9 to 11 minutes until golden at the edges. Cool on the sheet for 2 minutes.
chocolate-chip-cookies.note: Many chocolate chips contain soy lecithin; check your brand.

beef-burrito.title: Beef Burrito
beef-burrito.description: A big flour tortilla stuffed with seasoned ground beef, rice, beans and cheese.
steps: Brown the beef, drain the fat, then stir in the taco seasoning and 1/3 cup water and simmer 5 minutes.
Warm the beans and the tortillas.
Fill each tortilla with rice, beef, beans, cheese, salsa, sour cream and lettuce.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Toast seam side down in a dry skillet for 1 minute if you like.
beef-burrito.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

loaded-baked-potato.title: Loaded Baked Potato
loaded-baked-potato.description: Crisp-skinned baked potatoes loaded with butter, cheese, bacon, sour cream and chives.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Scrub and dry the potatoes, prick them, rub with oil and salt.
Bake directly on the rack for 50 to 60 minutes until tender.
Split open, fluff the insides and add butter.
Top with cheese and return to the oven for 3 minutes to melt.
Finish with bacon, sour cream and chives.
loaded-baked-potato.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

nachos.title: Loaded Beef Nachos
nachos.description: Tortilla chips layered with seasoned beef, beans, melted cheese and fresh toppings.
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
Brown the beef with the taco seasoning and a splash of water.
Spread the chips on a sheet pan and layer with beef, beans, cheese and jalapeños.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes until the cheese melts.
Top with pico de gallo, sour cream and guacamole.
nachos.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

garlic-butter-shrimp.title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
garlic-butter-shrimp.description: Juicy shrimp seared in garlic butter with lemon and parsley.
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the shrimp 1 to 2 minutes per side. Remove.
Add the remaining butter, garlic and pepper flakes and cook 30 seconds.
Return the shrimp with the lemon juice and parsley and toss to coat.
garlic-butter-shrimp.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chicken-tortilla-soup.title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
chicken-tortilla-soup.description: Smoky tomato and chicken soup topped with crisp tortilla strips, avocado and cheese.

ingredients.item: tortilla strips, avocado, cheese and cilantro

steps: Cook the onion, garlic and jalapeño in oil until soft. Add the spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth and chicken and simmer 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken and return it with the beans and corn. Simmer 5 minutes and add the lime juice.
Serve topped with tortilla strips, avocado, cheese and cilantro.
chicken-tortilla-soup.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

jambalaya.title: Jambalaya
jambalaya.description: Louisiana one-pot rice with andouille sausage, chicken and shrimp in a spicy Creole base.
steps: Brown the sausage and chicken in a heavy pot. Remove.
Cook the onion, pepper and celery until soft, then add the garlic.
Add the tomatoes, rice, broth, Creole seasoning, bay leaves, sausage and chicken. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes until the rice is tender.
Stir in the shrimp, cover and cook 5 minutes until pink. Top with green onions.
jambalaya.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

guacamole.title: Guacamole and Chips
guacamole.description: Chunky fresh avocado dip with lime, onion, jalapeño and cilantro, served with tortilla chips.
steps: Halve the avocados, remove the pits and scoop into a bowl.
Mash with a fork, leaving some chunks, and stir in the lime juice and salt.
Fold in the onion, jalapeño, tomato and cilantro. Taste and adjust.
Serve right away with tortilla chips.
guacamole.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

paella.title: Seafood Paella
paella.description: Spanish saffron rice with shrimp, mussels and squid, with a crisp golden crust on the bottom.
steps: Heat the oil in a paella pan and sear the shrimp and squid briefly. Remove.
Cook the onion and pepper until soft, add the garlic, tomato and paprika and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice to coat, then add the hot stock with the saffron and a good pinch of salt. Do not stir again.
Simmer 15 minutes, then nestle in the shrimp, squid, mussels and peas.
Cook 5 to 8 minutes more until the mussels open and the rice is tender. Raise the heat for the last minute to crisp the bottom.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with lemon and parsley.
paella.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chilaquiles.title: Chilaquiles Rojos
chilaquiles.description: Tortilla chips simmered in red chile salsa, topped with eggs, crema and fresh cheese.
steps: Heat the salsa and broth in a wide skillet until simmering.
Add the chips and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until coated but still a little crisp.
Fry the eggs in the oil.
Divide the chilaquiles onto plates and top with eggs, queso fresco, crema, onion, cilantro and avocado.
chilaquiles.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

gumbo.title: Chicken and Sausage Gumbo
gumbo.description: Rich, dark-roux Cajun stew with chicken, andouille and the holy trinity, served over rice.

ingredients.item: cooked white rice and filé powder

steps: Whisk the oil and flour in a heavy pot over medium heat, stirring constantly for 30 to 40 minutes until the roux is the color of dark chocolate.
Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook 5 minutes, then the garlic.
Slowly whisk in the stock, then add the chicken, sausage, seasoning and bay leaves.
Simmer 1 hour, skimming fat. Shred the chicken back into the pot.
Stir in the green onions and serve over rice with a pinch of filé.
gumbo.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

spaghetti-bolognese.title: Spaghetti Bolognese
spaghetti-bolognese.description: Slow-simmered beef and pork ragù with tomato and a splash of milk, tossed with spaghetti.
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the beef and pork and brown, breaking it up. Season with salt and pepper.
Pour in the wine and let it bubble away, then add the milk and simmer until absorbed.
Stir in the tomatoes and tomato paste and simmer very gently, partly covered, for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Cook the spaghetti, toss with the sauce and a splash of pasta water, and serve with Parmesan.
spaghetti-bolognese.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

fettuccine-alfredo.title: Fettuccine Alfredo
fettuccine-alfredo.description: Fettuccine in a silky sauce of butter, cream and Parmesan.
steps: Cook the fettuccine in salted water. Save 1 cup of pasta water.
Melt the butter with the cream and simmer 3 minutes.
Off the heat, toss in the drained pasta and Parmesan, adding pasta water until silky.
Season with pepper and nutmeg and top with parsley.
fettuccine-alfredo.note: Fresh egg fettuccine contains eggs; most dried fettuccine does not.

macaroni-and-cheese.title: Baked Macaroni and Cheese
macaroni-and-cheese.description: Creamy cheddar macaroni baked under a crunchy buttered breadcrumb top.

ingredients.item: panko breadcrumbs mixed with 1 tbsp melted butter

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the macaroni 2 minutes less than the package says and drain.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick.
Stir in 3 cups cheese, the mustard and salt until smooth.
Fold in the macaroni, pour into a baking dish and top with the remaining cheese and the breadcrumbs.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling and golden.
macaroni-and-cheese.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chicken-alfredo.title: Chicken Alfredo
chicken-alfredo.description: Fettuccine Alfredo topped with juicy seared chicken breast.
steps: Season the chicken with salt, pepper and Italian seasoning and sear in the oil 6 to 7 minutes per side. Rest and slice.
Cook the fettuccine and save some pasta water.
Melt the butter, cook the garlic 30 seconds, add the cream and simmer 4 minutes.
Stir in the Parmesan, then toss with the pasta, loosening with pasta water.
Top with the chicken and parsley.
chicken-alfredo.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

baked-ziti.title: Baked Ziti
baked-ziti.description: Ziti baked in marinara with ricotta, mozzarella and Parmesan.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the ziti 2 minutes less than the package says.
Brown the sausage and stir in the marinara and oregano.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and dollop half into a baking dish. Add spoonfuls of ricotta and half the mozzarella.
Add the rest of the pasta and top with the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes, uncover and bake 10 minutes more. Top with basil.
baked-ziti.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

spaghetti-carbonara.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
spaghetti-carbonara.description: Roman pasta with crisp guanciale, egg yolks and Pecorino, with no cream.

Whisk the yolks, egg, Pecorino and pepper.
Cook the spaghetti in lightly salted water, saving 1 cup of pasta water.
Add the hot drained pasta to the skillet, then off the heat stir in the egg mixture with splashes of pasta water until creamy, not scrambled.
Serve at once with more Pecorino and pepper.

lasagna.title: Beef Lasagna
lasagna.description: Layers of pasta, meat sauce, ricotta and melted mozzarella.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Brown the beef, sausage and onion, add the garlic, marinara and tomato sauce and simmer 15 minutes.
Cook the noodles. Mix the ricotta, egg, half the Parmesan and the parsley.
In a 9 x 13 dish, layer sauce, noodles, ricotta, mozzarella and sauce. Repeat twice, ending with sauce, mozzarella and Parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes, uncover and bake 25 minutes more.
Rest 15 minutes before cutting.

shrimp-scampi-pasta.title: Shrimp Scampi
shrimp-scampi-pasta.description: Linguine with shrimp in a garlicky white wine, lemon and butter sauce.
steps: Cook the linguine and save 1/2 cup of pasta water.
Heat the oil and 2 tbsp butter, cook the shrimp 1 minute per side and remove.
Add the garlic and pepper flakes for 30 seconds, then the wine and simmer 2 minutes.
Add the remaining butter, lemon, pasta, shrimp and parsley, tossing with pasta water until glossy.

pesto-pasta.title: Pesto Pasta

Toss the pasta with the pesto, loosening with pasta water.

Fry in oil 3 minutes per side until golden.

Bake 10 to 15 minutes until bubbling. Top with basil and serve with spaghetti.

Season the tomatoes with salt.
Stretch half the dough into a 12-inch round, spread with tomato and top with mozzarella.

Put the onion in a slow cooker, add the pork and pour in the vinegar.

Shred the pork, discard excess fat, and toss with the barbecue sauce.

Add the onion, garlic and jalapeño and cook 5 minutes.

caesar-salad.description: Crisp romaine with homemade croutons, Parmesan and a creamy anchovy-garlic dressing.
steps: Toss the bread with 2 tbsp oil and bake at 375°F for 10 minutes until golden.
Mash the anchovies and garlic, then whisk in the yolk, lemon and mustard.
Slowly whisk in the 1/2 cup oil until thick, then stir in half the Parmesan.
Toss the romaine with the dressing, croutons and the remaining Parmesan.
caesar-salad.note: The dressing uses a raw egg yolk. Use a pasteurized egg if you prefer.

buttermilk-pancakes.title: Buttermilk Pancakes

ingredients.item: butter and maple syrup, to serve

steps: Whisk the dry ingredients together.
Whisk the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined. Lumps are fine.
Cook 1/4-cup portions on a buttered griddle over medium heat until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Serve with butter and syrup.

scrambled-eggs.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs
steps: Whisk the eggs with the milk and a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat.
Add the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula, pushing them from the edges, until softly set, about 3 minutes.
Take off the heat while still glossy and top with pepper and chives.
scrambled-eggs.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

cobb-salad.title: Cobb Salad

steps: Spread the romaine on a platter.
Arrange the chicken, bacon, eggs, avocado, tomatoes and blue cheese in rows on top.
Drizzle with vinaigrette at the table and toss.
cobb-salad.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

greek-salad.title: Greek Salad
greek-salad.description: Tomatoes, cucumber, peppers, onion and olives with a slab of feta and oregano.
steps: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, onion and olives in a bowl.
Season with salt and dress with the oil and vinegar.
Top with the feta and sprinkle with oregano.
greek-salad.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

coleslaw.title: Creamy Coleslaw
coleslaw.description: Crunchy cabbage and carrot slaw in a tangy, creamy dressing.
steps: Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, mustard and celery seed.
Toss with the cabbage and carrot and season.
Chill 30 minutes before serving.
coleslaw.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

beef-pot-roast.title: Beef Pot Roast
beef-pot-roast.description: Fork-tender braised chuck roast with carrots, potatoes and rich gravy.
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F. Season the roast well and brown it on all sides in the oil.
Add the onion and garlic, then the tomato paste, wine, broth and herbs.
Cover and braise in the oven 2 1/2 hours.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook 1 hour more until tender.
Thicken the liquid with the flour mixture on the stove to make gravy.
beef-pot-roast.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

french-toast.title: French Toast
french-toast.description: Thick slices of bread soaked in cinnamon custard and griddled until golden.
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon and vanilla.
Soak each slice for 20 seconds per side.
Cook in butter on a griddle over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with syrup and powdered sugar.
french-toast.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chicken-tacos.title: Chicken Tacos
chicken-tacos.description: Spiced, charred chicken thighs in warm corn tortillas with onion, cilantro and lime.
steps: Toss the chicken with the oil, spices, salt and the juice of 1 lime.
Cook in a hot skillet or grill 5 to 6 minutes per side until charred and cooked. Rest and chop.
Fill the tortillas with chicken, onion and cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges and salsa verde.
chicken-tacos.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

eggs-benedict.title: Eggs Benedict
eggs-benedict.description: Poached eggs and Canadian bacon on English muffins under silky hollandaise.

Warm the Canadian bacon in a skillet.
Bring water with the vinegar to a gentle simmer and poach the eggs 3 minutes.
Top each muffin half with bacon, an egg and hollandaise.
eggs-benedict.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

ingredients.item: diced cooked potatoes or hash browns

steps: Brown the sausage, then add the potatoes and cook until crisp.
Push to one side and scramble the eggs until just set. Season.
Warm the tortillas and fill with sausage, potatoes, eggs, cheese and salsa.
Roll up tightly and toast seam side down in the skillet for 1 minute.
breakfast-burrito.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

beef-stew.title: Beef Stew

Cook the onion and garlic, stir in the tomato paste, then add the broth, Worcestershire, bay leaves and thyme.
Return the beef, cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Add the carrots and potatoes and simmer 45 minutes until tender.
Stir in the peas for the last 5 minutes and season.
beef-stew.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

pad-thai.title: Shrimp Pad Thai

Add the bean sprouts and green onions for 30 seconds.
Serve topped with peanuts, lime and chili flakes.

ingredients.item: large chicken breasts, halved and pounded thin

steps: Season the chicken and dredge in flour.
Brown in the oil and 1 tbsp butter 3 to 4 minutes per side. Remove.
Add 1 tbsp butter and the mushrooms and cook until browned, then the garlic.
Add the Marsala and broth and simmer until reduced by half. Swirl in the last of the butter.
Return the chicken to warm through and top with parsley.

beef-stroganoff.description: Tender strips of beef and mushrooms in a creamy sour cream sauce over egg noodles.
steps: Sear the beef in the oil in batches over high heat. Remove.
Melt the butter and cook the onion and mushrooms until browned.
Stir in the flour, then the broth and mustard, and simmer until thick.
Off the heat, stir in the sour cream and the beef.
Serve over the cooked noodles with parsley.
beef-stroganoff.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

shakshuka.title: Shakshuka
shakshuka.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce, from North Africa and the Middle East.
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil until soft, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the tomatoes, season and simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Make 6 wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook 5 to 8 minutes until the whites set.
Top with feta and cilantro and serve with bread.
shakshuka.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

falafel-plate.title: Falafel Plate
falafel-plate.description: Crisp herb-packed chickpea falafel with tahini sauce, salad and pita.
steps: Drain the chickpeas well and pulse in a food processor with the onion, garlic, herbs, spices and salt until finely ground but not pasty.
Stir in the baking soda and shape into small balls or patties.
Fry at 350°F for 3 to 4 minutes until deep brown.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice and water to a pourable sauce with a pinch of salt.
Serve with pita, salad, pickles and tahini sauce.

eggplant-parmesan.title: Eggplant Parmesan
eggplant-parmesan.description: Crisp breaded eggplant layered with marinara, mozzarella and Parmesan.
steps: Salt the eggplant, let stand 30 minutes and pat dry.
Dredge in flour, dip in egg and coat in breadcrumbs. Fry until golden on both sides.
Heat the oven to 375°F. Layer sauce, eggplant, mozzarella and Parmesan in a baking dish, repeating twice.
Bake 30 minutes until bubbling. Rest 10 minutes and top with basil.

Mix the yogurt and garlic. Melt the butter with the pepper and mint.

salt, oil for the pan, coconut chutney and sambar

death-in-the-afternoon.description: Absinthe topped with Champagne until it clouds, Hemingway's creation.
steps: Pour the absinthe into a coupe or flute.
Slowly add Champagne until it turns milky.
death-in-the-afternoon.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

nasi-goreng.title: Nasi Goreng
nasi-goreng.description: Indonesian fried rice with sweet soy sauce and shrimp paste, topped with a fried egg.
steps: Fry the shallots, garlic, chile and shrimp paste in the oil until fragrant.
Add the chicken or shrimp and cook through.
Add the rice, kecap manis and soy sauce and toss over high heat until hot and lightly charred.
Serve topped with a fried egg, with cucumber, tomato and fried shallots.
nasi-goreng.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

queen-s-park-swizzle.title: Queen's Park Swizzle
queen-s-park-swizzle.description: Demerara rum swizzled with mint, lime and Angostura bitters in layers.
steps: Lightly press the mint in a Collins glass with the syrup and lime.
Add the rum, fill with crushed ice and swizzle until frosty.
Top with more ice and dash the bitters over the top.
queen-s-park-swizzle.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

remember-the-maine.description: Rye, sweet vermouth and cherry liqueur with an absinthe rinse.
steps: Rinse a chilled coupe with absinthe.
Stir the rest with ice and strain into the glass.

laksa.title: Curry Laksa
laksa.description: Malaysian noodle soup in a spicy coconut curry broth with shrimp, tofu puffs and sprouts.

ingredients.item: cilantro, mint, lime wedges and sliced chiles

steps: Fry the laksa paste in the oil for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the stock and coconut milk and simmer 10 minutes. Season with fish sauce and sugar.
Add the shrimp and tofu puffs and cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Divide the noodles and sprouts among bowls and ladle the broth over.
Top with herbs, chiles and lime.
laksa.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

bun-cha.description: Hanoi-style grilled pork patties in a sweet-sour dipping broth with rice noodles and herbs.

ingredients.item: lettuce, mint, cilantro, Thai basil, pickled carrot and chiles

steps: Mix the pork with 1 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, shallots, half the garlic and the pepper. Shape into small patties.
Grill or broil the patties until charred and cooked, about 4 minutes per side.
Stir the remaining fish sauce, sugar and garlic with the lime juice and warm water for the dipping broth.
Put the patties in bowls of the broth and serve with noodles, herbs and pickles to dip.
bun-cha.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

steps: Shake everything hard with ice.

pink-squirrel.note: Crème de noyaux is flavored with apricot kernels or almonds.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Raspberry, lime and ginger beer.

steps: Shake everything with ice.

steps: Dry-shake everything, then shake again with ice.
Strain into a small chilled glass and grate nutmeg on top.
porto-flip.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

cochinita-pibil.title: Cochinita Pibil
cochinita-pibil.description: Yucatán slow-roasted pork marinated in achiote and citrus, with pickled red onions.

ingredients.item: pork shoulder, cut into large chunks
red onion, thinly sliced and soaked in lime juice with salt

steps: Blend the achiote, citrus juices, garlic, cumin, oregano and salt.
Coat the pork and marinate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Line a baking dish with banana leaves or foil, add the pork and marinade and wrap tightly.
Roast at 325°F for 3 1/2 to 4 hours until it shreds easily.
Shred and serve in tortillas with the pickled onions and salsa.
cochinita-pibil.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

huevos-rancheros.title: Huevos Rancheros
huevos-rancheros.description: Fried eggs on crisp corn tortillas with ranchero salsa, beans and fresh cheese.

ingredients.item: ranchero sauce or warm tomato salsa

steps: Fry the tortillas in oil until lightly crisp. Drain.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Spread each tortilla with beans, top with an egg and spoon over the sauce.
Finish with queso fresco, avocado and cilantro.
huevos-rancheros.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

banh-mi.title: Pork Banh Mi
banh-mi.description: Vietnamese baguette with lemongrass pork, pickled vegetables, cilantro, chiles and mayo.

ingredients.item: Vietnamese baguettes or soft French rolls

steps: Toss the carrot and daikon in the sweetened vinegar and let stand 30 minutes.
Marinate the pork in the lemongrass, fish sauce, soy sauce and sugar for 20 minutes.
Sear the pork in a hot skillet until caramelized.
Split and toast the rolls, spread with mayonnaise and fill with pork, pickles, cucumber, cilantro and jalapeño.
banh-mi.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

mole-poblano.title: Mole Poblano
mole-poblano.description: Chicken in Puebla's rich, dark sauce of dried chiles, spices, nuts and chocolate.

ingredients.item: sesame seeds, plus more to serve

steps: Simmer the chicken in salted water until cooked, about 40 minutes. Keep the broth.
Toast the chiles briefly and soak in hot water 20 minutes.
Toast the almonds, sesame seeds, raisins, tortilla and bread in a little oil.
Blend everything except the chicken and chocolate with broth until very smooth.
Fry the sauce in oil for 10 minutes, add the chocolate and more broth and simmer 30 minutes until thick.
Add the chicken to warm through and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
mole-poblano.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

pupusas.title: Pupusas
pupusas.description: Salvadoran stuffed corn cakes with cheese and beans, served with curtido slaw.
steps: Mix the cabbage, carrot, vinegar, oregano and salt for the curtido and chill.
Mix the masa, water and a pinch of salt into a soft dough.
With wet hands, flatten a ball of dough, fill with cheese and beans, close and pat into a 1/2-inch disk.
Cook on a hot griddle 3 to 4 minutes per side until spotted brown.
Serve with curtido and salsa.
pupusas.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

Strain into an ice-filled highball and top with ginger beer.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Blackcurrant syrup, lime and ginger beer.

pozole-rojo.title: Pozole Rojo
pozole-rojo.description: Mexican pork and hominy stew in a red chile broth, with crunchy toppings.

ingredients.item: shredded cabbage, radishes, onion, lime and tostadas

steps: Simmer the pork with the onion, half the garlic and salt in 3 quarts of water for 1 1/2 hours.
Soak the chiles in hot water, then blend with the remaining garlic, oregano and a cup of broth. Strain.
Add the chile puree and hominy to the pot and simmer 45 minutes.
Shred the pork and season.
Serve with the toppings.
pozole-rojo.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

peruvian-ceviche.title: Peruvian Ceviche
peruvian-ceviche.description: Fresh fish cured in lime juice with red onion, chile and cilantro, served with sweet potato and corn.

ingredients.item: very fresh firm white fish, cubed
corn, boiled and cut into rounds

steps: Toss the fish with the salt, garlic and chile.
Pour over the lime juice and let stand 10 to 15 minutes until the outside turns opaque.
Add the onion and cilantro.
Serve right away with sweet potato and corn.
peruvian-ceviche.note: Use the freshest, sushi-grade fish you can get.

tamales.title: Pork Tamales
tamales.description: Steamed masa dough wrapped in corn husks around red chile pork.
steps: Beat the lard until fluffy, then beat in the masa, baking powder, salt and broth until a bit of dough floats in water.
Mix the pork with the chile sauce.
Spread a thin layer of masa on each husk, add a spoon of filling and fold the sides and bottom over.
Stand the tamales upright in a steamer and steam 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the masa pulls away from the husk.
tamales.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

arepas.title: Arepas
arepas.description: Golden Venezuelan corn cakes split and stuffed with cheese and fillings.

ingredients.item: fillings: shredded beef, black beans or avocado

steps: Mix the masarepa, water and salt into a soft dough and rest 5 minutes.
Shape into 8 disks about 1/2 inch thick.
Cook in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat 5 to 6 minutes per side until crusty.
Split open and stuff with cheese and fillings.
arepas.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

lomo-saltado.title: Lomo Saltado
lomo-saltado.description: Peruvian stir-fried beef with onions, tomatoes and soy, served with fries and rice.

ingredients.item: aji amarillo or yellow chile, sliced

steps: Season the beef and sear in a very hot wok in batches. Remove.
Stir-fry the onion and chile for 1 minute, then the garlic.
Return the beef, add the soy sauce and vinegar, then the tomatoes for 30 seconds.
Toss with cilantro and the fries and serve with rice.
lomo-saltado.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

beef-empanadas.title: Beef Empanadas
beef-empanadas.description: Flaky baked pastries filled with spiced beef, onion, olives and egg.
steps: Cook the onion and pepper until soft, add the beef and spices and cook through. Stir in the olives and cool.
Heat the oven to 400°F.
Fill each round with beef and a little egg, fold over and crimp the edges.
Brush with beaten egg and bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden.
beef-empanadas.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

choripan.title: Choripán
choripan.description: Argentine grilled chorizo sandwiches with bright chimichurri.
steps: Mix the parsley, garlic, oregano, pepper flakes, vinegar and oil with a pinch of salt for the chimichurri.
Grill the chorizo over medium heat 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Split the sausages lengthwise and grill the cut side briefly.
Toast the rolls, add the chorizo and spoon on chimichurri.
choripan.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

takoyaki.title: Takoyaki
takoyaki.description: Japanese octopus-filled batter balls topped with sauce, mayo, bonito flakes and seaweed.

ingredients.item: takoyaki sauce, Japanese mayo, bonito flakes and aonori

steps: Whisk the flour, eggs, dashi and soy sauce into a thin batter.
Heat an oiled takoyaki pan and fill the holes with batter.
Drop in octopus, green onion, ginger and tempura bits.
After 1 to 2 minutes, turn each ball with a skewer, tucking in the edges, and keep turning until round and golden.
Top with sauce, mayo, bonito flakes and aonori.
takoyaki.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

cabbage-rolls.title: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
cabbage-rolls.description: Cabbage leaves rolled around beef and rice, baked in a sweet-sour tomato sauce.
steps: Core the cabbage and boil it whole, peeling off 12 leaves as they soften. Trim the thick ribs.
Mix the meats, rice, onion, garlic, paprika, salt and pepper.
Roll a portion of filling in each leaf, tucking in the sides.
Mix the tomatoes, sugar and lemon juice. Spread some in a dish, add the rolls and cover with the rest.
Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 1/2 hours.
cabbage-rolls.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

goulash.title: Hungarian Goulash
goulash.description: Hearty Hungarian beef and paprika stew with peppers and potatoes.
steps: Brown the beef in the fat in batches. Remove.
Cook the onions slowly until golden, then off the heat stir in the paprika and caraway.
Add the garlic, tomato paste, beef and broth and simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Add the peppers and potatoes and simmer 30 minutes until tender. Season.
Serve with a dollop of sour cream if you like.
goulash.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

pork-schnitzel.title: Pork Schnitzel
pork-schnitzel.description: Thin pork cutlets in a crisp, golden breadcrumb coating, served with lemon.

ingredients.item: boneless pork chops, pounded to 1/4 inch
large eggs, beaten with 1 tbsp water
vegetable oil or lard, for frying

steps: Season the pork with salt and pepper.
Dredge in flour, dip in egg and coat lightly in breadcrumbs without pressing.
Shallow-fry in 1/2 inch of hot oil, swirling the pan, 2 to 3 minutes per side until puffed and golden.
Drain and serve with lemon wedges.
pork-schnitzel.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

sauerbraten.title: Sauerbraten
sauerbraten.description: German pot roast marinated for days in spiced vinegar, with a sweet-sour gingersnap gravy.
steps: Boil the vinegar, water, vegetables, spices and sugar with 1 tsp salt. Cool and pour over the beef.
Marinate in the fridge 3 days, turning daily.
Dry the beef and brown it in the oil, then add the strained marinade. Cover and simmer 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
Remove the beef. Stir the gingersnaps and raisins into the liquid and simmer until thick.
Slice the beef and serve with the gravy.
sauerbraten.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

japchae.title: Japchae
japchae.description: Korean sweet potato glass noodles stir-fried with beef and vegetables in sesame-soy sauce.
steps: Cook the noodles 6 minutes, rinse and cut a few times with scissors.
Mix the soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil and garlic. Marinate the beef in 2 tbsp of it.
Stir-fry the vegetables one at a time until just tender, then the beef.
Toss everything with the noodles and the rest of the sauce. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
japchae.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chicken-shawarma.title: Chicken Shawarma
chicken-shawarma.description: Spiced, charred chicken thighs wrapped in pita with garlic sauce, pickles and vegetables.
steps: Marinate the chicken in the yogurt, lemon, spices, garlic and salt for at least 2 hours.
Roast at 425°F or grill 20 minutes until charred and cooked. Rest and slice thinly.
Warm the pitas.
Fill with chicken, vegetables, pickles and sauce, and roll up.
chicken-shawarma.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

beef-kofta.title: Beef Kofta
beef-kofta.description: Grilled skewers of spiced ground beef and onion, served with yogurt sauce.

ingredients.item: small onion, grated and squeezed dry
plain yogurt with grated cucumber and mint

steps: Knead the meat with the onion, parsley, garlic, spices and salt until sticky.
Shape around skewers into long sausages.
Grill over medium-high heat 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until cooked.
Serve with the yogurt sauce, flatbread and salad.
beef-kofta.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

bratwurst-with-sauerkraut.title: Bratwurst with Sauerkraut
bratwurst-with-sauerkraut.description: Beer-simmered then seared bratwurst over warm sauerkraut with mustard.
steps: Simmer the brats and onion in the beer for 15 minutes.
Sear the brats in a hot skillet or grill until browned.
Warm the sauerkraut with the onions, butter and caraway.
Serve the brats on the sauerkraut with mustard.

okonomiyaki.title: Okonomiyaki
okonomiyaki.description: Japanese savory cabbage pancake with pork belly, topped with sauce, mayo and bonito flakes.

ingredients.item: okonomiyaki sauce, Japanese mayo, bonito flakes and aonori

steps: Whisk the flour, dashi and eggs, then fold in the cabbage and green onions.
Spread half the batter in an oiled pan into a thick round and lay pork belly on top.
Cook 5 minutes over medium heat, flip and cook 5 minutes more until the pork is crisp.
Top with sauce, mayo, bonito flakes and aonori. Repeat with the rest.
okonomiyaki.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chicken-adobo.title: Chicken Adobo
chicken-adobo.description: Filipino chicken braised in vinegar, soy sauce, garlic and bay leaves until glossy.
steps: Combine the chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves and peppercorns and marinate 30 minutes.
Brown the chicken in the oil skin side down, then add the marinade and 1/2 cup water.
Simmer, covered, 30 minutes, then uncovered 10 minutes until the sauce reduces. Stir in the sugar.
Serve with steamed rice.
chicken-adobo.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

mushroom-risotto.title: Mushroom Risotto
mushroom-risotto.description: Creamy Arborio rice with sautéed mushrooms, white wine and Parmesan.

ingredients.item: chicken or vegetable stock, kept hot

steps: Brown the mushrooms in the oil and 1 tbsp butter and set aside.
Cook the shallot in 1 tbsp butter, add the rice and toast 2 minutes.
Add the wine and stir until absorbed, then add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18 to 20 minutes until creamy and just tender.
Stir in the mushrooms, remaining butter and Parmesan. Season and top with parsley.
mushroom-risotto.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

pierogi.title: Potato and Cheese Pierogi
pierogi.description: Polish dumplings filled with potato and cheddar, pan-fried with butter and onions.
steps: Mix the flour, egg, sour cream, water and a pinch of salt into a soft dough. Rest 30 minutes.
Mix the potatoes and cheese and season.
Roll the dough thin and cut 3-inch circles. Fill, fold and pinch tightly.
Boil in salted water until they float, plus 2 minutes.
Fry the onion in the butter until golden, add the pierogi and fry until crisp. Serve with sour cream.
pierogi.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

stuffed-bell-peppers.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
stuffed-bell-peppers.description: Bell peppers filled with beef, rice and tomato, baked under melted cheese.

ingredients.item: bell peppers, tops cut and seeded

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the beef with the onion and garlic, then stir in the rice, tomatoes, half the tomato sauce and seasoning.
Stand the peppers in a baking dish, fill them and top with the rest of the sauce.
Cover and bake 35 minutes, top with cheese and bake 10 minutes more.
stuffed-bell-peppers.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chicken-cordon-bleu.title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
chicken-cordon-bleu.description: Chicken breasts rolled around ham and Swiss cheese, breaded and baked.
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Lay a slice of ham and cheese on each breast, roll up and secure with toothpicks.
Dredge in flour, dip in egg and coat in panko mixed with the butter.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes until golden and 165°F inside.
Remove the toothpicks and serve with Dijon.
chicken-cordon-bleu.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

beef-bulgogi.title: Beef Bulgogi
beef-bulgogi.description: Thin slices of beef in a sweet soy, garlic and sesame marinade, quickly seared.
steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, pear, sesame oil, garlic and ginger. Marinate the beef 30 minutes or longer.
Cook in a very hot skillet in batches 2 to 3 minutes until caramelized.
Top with green onions and sesame seeds and serve with rice and lettuce leaves.
beef-bulgogi.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

suffering-bastard.title: Suffering Bastard

steps: Shake the gin, brandy, lime and bitters with ice.
