golden-cadillac.title: Golden Cadillac
golden-cadillac.description: Galliano and white crème de cacao shaken with cream.
steps: Shake everything hard with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
golden-cadillac.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

lamb-tagine.title: Lamb Tagine
lamb-tagine.description: Moroccan lamb slow-cooked with warm spices, apricots and honey, finished with almonds.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil. Remove.
Cook the onion, garlic and ginger, then the spices for 1 minute.
Return the lamb with the broth, cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours.
Add the apricots and honey and cook 30 minutes until the lamb is tender.
Top with almonds and serve with couscous.
lamb-tagine.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

thai-green-curry.title: Thai Green Curry
thai-green-curry.description: Chicken and vegetables in a fragrant green curry with coconut milk and Thai basil.
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil and a few spoonfuls of thick coconut cream until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook 3 minutes.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, eggplant and lime leaves and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the pepper and season with fish sauce and sugar.
Stir in the basil and serve with jasmine rice.
thai-green-curry.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

stinger.title: Stinger
stinger.description: Cognac and white crème de menthe, an after-dinner classic.
steps: Stir or shake with ice.
Strain into a coupe or over crushed ice.
stinger.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

chicken-piccata.title: Chicken Piccata
chicken-piccata.description: Thin chicken cutlets in a lemony butter and caper sauce.

ingredients.item: large chicken breasts, halved and pounded thin

steps: Season the chicken and dredge in flour.
Brown in the oil and 1 tbsp butter 3 minutes per side. Remove.
Add the broth, wine, lemon and capers and simmer until reduced by half.
Swirl in the remaining butter, return the chicken and top with parsley.
chicken-piccata.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

navy-grog.title: Navy Grog
navy-grog.description: Three rums with lime, grapefruit and honey over a cone of ice.
steps: Shake everything except the soda with ice.
Strain over crushed ice in a double rocks glass and top with soda.
navy-grog.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

toronto.title: Toronto
toronto.description: Rye with Fernet-Branca, sugar and bitters.
steps: Stir everything with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
toronto.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

bibimbap.title: Bibimbap
bibimbap.description: Korean rice bowl with seasoned vegetables, beef, a fried egg and gochujang sauce.
steps: Cook the beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce, sugar and 1 tsp sesame oil.
Season the spinach and sprouts with a little sesame oil, soy and salt. Sauté the carrot and zucchini separately.
Fry the eggs sunny side up.
Mix the gochujang with 1 tbsp sesame oil and a splash of water.
Fill bowls with rice, arrange the vegetables and beef on top, add an egg and serve with the sauce and sesame seeds.
bibimbap.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

beef-bourguignon.title: Beef Bourguignon
beef-bourguignon.description: French beef braised in red wine with bacon, mushrooms and pearl onions.
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F. Cook the bacon in a Dutch oven and remove. Brown the beef in the fat in batches.
Return the beef and bacon, toss with the flour, then add the wine, broth, tomato paste, garlic and herbs.
Cover and braise 2 1/2 hours. Add the carrots for the last hour.
Brown the onions and mushrooms in the butter and stir into the stew.
Season and serve with potatoes or crusty bread.
beef-bourguignon.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

southside.title: Southside
southside.description: Gin, lime, sugar and fresh mint, shaken.
steps: Shake everything with ice.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Shake lime, syrup and mint and top with soda.

southside.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

jasmine.title: Jasmine
jasmine.description: Gin, Campari, orange liqueur and lemon. Tastes like grapefruit juice.
steps: Shake everything with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
jasmine.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

osso-buco.title: Osso Buco
osso-buco.description: Milanese braised veal shanks in white wine and tomato, topped with gremolata.
steps: Tie each shank around the middle, season and dredge in flour. Brown well in the oil.
Cook the onion, carrot and celery until soft, add the wine and reduce by half.
Add the tomatoes and stock, return the shanks, cover and simmer 2 to 2 1/2 hours until very tender.
Mix the lemon zest, parsley and garlic for the gremolata.
Serve with saffron risotto or polenta, topped with gremolata.
osso-buco.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

naked-and-famous.title: Naked and Famous
naked-and-famous.description: Equal parts mezcal, yellow Chartreuse, Aperol and lime.
steps: Shake everything with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
naked-and-famous.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

coq-au-vin.title: Coq au Vin
coq-au-vin.description: French chicken braised in red wine with mushrooms, bacon and onions.
steps: Cook the bacon and remove. Brown the seasoned chicken in the fat and remove.
Stir the flour into the fat, then add the wine, broth, tomato paste, garlic and herbs.
Return the chicken and bacon, cover and simmer 45 minutes.
Brown the mushrooms and onions in the butter, add to the pot and simmer 20 minutes more.
Season and serve with mashed potatoes or bread.
coq-au-vin.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

chicken-cacciatore.title: Chicken Cacciatore
chicken-cacciatore.description: Italian hunter-style chicken braised with tomatoes, peppers, mushrooms and herbs.
steps: Season and brown the chicken in the oil. Remove.
Cook the onion, pepper and mushrooms until soft, then add the garlic.
Add the wine and reduce, then the tomatoes and herbs.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer 35 to 40 minutes. Season and top with basil.
chicken-cacciatore.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

moussaka.title: Moussaka
moussaka.description: Greek baked layers of eggplant, spiced lamb sauce and creamy béchamel.
steps: Brush the eggplant with oil and roast at 425°F for 20 minutes until golden.
Brown the meat with the onion and garlic, add the tomatoes and spices and simmer 20 minutes.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then the milk and cook until thick. Off the heat, whisk in the yolks and half the cheese.
Layer half the eggplant, the meat, then the rest of the eggplant in a dish. Pour over the béchamel and top with cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes until golden. Rest 20 minutes before cutting.
moussaka.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

beef-wellington.title: Beef Wellington
beef-wellington.description: Beef tenderloin wrapped in mushroom duxelles, prosciutto and golden puff pastry.
steps: Season and sear the beef on all sides in the oil. Brush with mustard and cool.
Cook the mushrooms and shallots in the butter until all the moisture is gone. Cool.
Lay the prosciutto overlapping on plastic wrap, spread with the mushrooms, set the beef on top and roll tightly. Chill 20 minutes.
Wrap in the rolled-out pastry, seal, brush with egg and chill 15 minutes.
Bake at 425°F for 35 to 40 minutes until 125°F inside for medium-rare. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.
beef-wellington.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

airmail.title: Airmail
airmail.description: Rum, lime and honey topped with Champagne.
steps: Shake the rum, lime and honey with ice.
Strain into a flute and top with Champagne.

cocktail.non_alcoholic_version: Lime and honey topped with alcohol-free sparkling wine.

airmail.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

army-and-navy.title: Army and Navy
steps: Shake everything with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
army-and-navy.note: A classic home version. Bars vary the proportions, and this isn't any one bar's recipe. Please drink responsibly.

nigerian-suya.title: Nigerian Suya
nigerian-suya.description: Spicy grilled beef skewers coated in a peanut and chile spice blend.

ingredients.item: sliced red onion, tomatoes and cabbage

steps: Mix the ground peanuts, spices and bouillon to make yaji spice.
Toss the beef with the oil and most of the spice and marinate 1 hour.
Thread onto skewers and grill 5 to 6 minutes per side.
Dust with more spice and serve with onion, tomato and cabbage.
nigerian-suya.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

west-african-egusi-soup.title: Egusi Soup
west-african-egusi-soup.description: West African stew thickened with ground melon seeds, with greens and meat or fish.

ingredients.item: scotch bonnet peppers, blended with 2 tomatoes
beef or goat, cooked, with its stock

steps: Mix the egusi with a little water into a paste.
Heat the palm oil, cook the onion, then add the pepper and tomato blend and cook 10 minutes.
Add the egusi in spoonfuls and fry gently 10 minutes, stirring.
Add the meat with 3 cups stock, the fish, crayfish and bouillon and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the greens, cook 5 minutes and season. Serve with fufu or pounded yam.
west-african-egusi-soup.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

ethiopian-tibs.title: Ethiopian Tibs
ethiopian-tibs.description: Sautéed beef cubes with onion, peppers, rosemary and spiced butter.
steps: Sear the beef in a very hot skillet with half the butter until browned. Remove.
Cook the onion, jalapeños, garlic and ginger in the remaining butter.
Return the beef with the berbere and rosemary and toss 2 to 3 minutes.
Season and serve with injera.
ethiopian-tibs.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

jollof-rice.title: Jollof Rice
jollof-rice.description: West African rice cooked in a smoky, spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
steps: Blend the tomatoes, peppers, scotch bonnet and 1 onion until smooth.
Cook the other onion, sliced, in the oil, then fry the tomato paste 3 minutes.
Add the blended sauce, spices and bay leaves and cook 15 minutes until reduced.
Stir in the rice and stock, season, cover tightly and cook on low 30 minutes until tender.
Let the bottom toast slightly for a smoky flavor, then fluff and serve.
jollof-rice.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

ghanaian-red-red.title: Ghanaian Red Red
ghanaian-red-red.description: Black-eyed peas stewed in red palm oil and tomato, served with fried plantains.
steps: Heat the palm oil and cook the onion, garlic, ginger and pepper until soft.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the black-eyed peas and 1/2 cup water and simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few. Season.
Fry the plantains until caramelized and serve alongside.
ghanaian-red-red.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

senegalese-thieboudienne.title: Thieboudienne
senegalese-thieboudienne.description: Senegal's national dish of fish and vegetables cooked in tomato, with the rice cooked in the broth.

ingredients.item: cassava or sweet potato, in chunks

steps: Cut slits in the fish and stuff with the rof. Brown the fish in the oil and remove.
Cook the onion, then the tomato paste for 5 minutes. Add 8 cups water and the bouillon.
Add the vegetables and fish and simmer until each is tender, lifting them out as they are done.
Measure about 4 1/2 cups of the broth into the pot, add the rice, cover and cook on low 25 minutes.
Serve the rice topped with the fish and vegetables.
senegalese-thieboudienne.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

south-african-bobotie.title: South African Bobotie
south-african-bobotie.description: Curried, gently sweet minced beef baked under a savory egg custard.

ingredients.item: white bread, soaked in 1 cup milk

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Cook the onion and garlic, add the beef and brown, then the spices for 1 minute.
Squeeze the bread, keeping the milk, and mix it into the beef with the jam, raisins, almonds and lemon juice.
Spread in a baking dish. Whisk the eggs with the saved milk, pour over and top with bay leaves.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until the custard is set and golden.
south-african-bobotie.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

persian-tahdig.title: Persian Tahdig
persian-tahdig.description: Saffron basmati rice with a crunchy golden crust from the bottom of the pot.

ingredients.item: saffron, ground and steeped in 3 tbsp hot water

steps: Boil the rice in plenty of salted water for 6 minutes and drain.
Mix 1 1/2 cups of the rice with the yogurt and half the saffron.
Heat the oil and half the butter in a nonstick pot and press the yogurt rice firmly over the bottom.
Mound the rest of the rice on top, poke holes, drizzle with butter and saffron. Wrap the lid in a towel and cover.
Cook 10 minutes on medium, then 50 minutes on low. Turn out onto a plate so the crust is on top.
persian-tahdig.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

moroccan-harira.title: Moroccan Harira
moroccan-harira.description: Spiced tomato, lentil and chickpea soup, traditional for breaking the Ramadan fast.
steps: Brown the meat in the oil with the onion and celery, then add the spices.
Add the tomatoes, water and lentils and simmer 40 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and vermicelli and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the flour mixture to thicken and the herbs. Season and serve with lemon.
moroccan-harira.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

egyptian-koshari.title: Egyptian Koshari
egyptian-koshari.description: Rice, lentils and pasta topped with spicy tomato sauce, chickpeas and crispy onions.
steps: Fry the onions in the oil until dark and crisp. Drain, keeping the oil.
Cook the lentils 15 minutes, add the rice, a spoon of onion oil and water to cover, and cook until both are tender.
Boil the macaroni.
Cook the garlic in a little oil, add the tomato sauce, cumin, chili and vinegar and simmer 10 minutes.
Layer rice and lentils, macaroni, chickpeas and sauce, and top with crispy onions.
egyptian-koshari.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

indian-pav-bhaji.title: Pav Bhaji
indian-pav-bhaji.description: Mumbai street food: buttery mashed spiced vegetables with toasted soft rolls.

ingredients.item: butter, plus more for the rolls
lemon wedges, chopped onion and cilantro

steps: Mash the potatoes, cauliflower and peas.
Cook the onion and pepper in butter, add the ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes and masala and cook until soft.
Add the mashed vegetables and 1 cup water and mash everything together. Simmer 10 minutes.
Split the rolls and toast in butter.
Serve the bhaji topped with butter, onion and cilantro, with lemon and the rolls.
indian-pav-bhaji.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

pakistani-nihari.title: Pakistani Nihari
pakistani-nihari.description: Slow-cooked beef shank stew with deep spices, thickened with flour and topped with ginger and chiles.

ingredients.item: atta or all-purpose flour mixed with 1 cup water
julienned ginger, green chiles, cilantro and lemon

steps: Cook the onion in the ghee until golden, then the ginger-garlic paste and spices.
Add the beef and brown, then cover with 10 cups water and simmer very gently 4 hours until it falls apart.
Stir in the flour slurry and simmer 20 minutes until thick and glossy. Season.
Serve with the ginger, chiles, cilantro and lemon, and naan.
pakistani-nihari.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

tunisian-couscous.title: Tunisian Couscous
tunisian-couscous.description: Couscous with lamb and vegetables in a spicy harissa and tomato broth.
steps: Brown the lamb and onion in the oil, then add the tomato paste, harissa and spices.
Add 6 cups water and simmer 45 minutes.
Add the carrots and potato, then the zucchini and chickpeas, and cook until tender.
Steam or soak the couscous in some of the broth with a little oil.
Mound the couscous, top with meat and vegetables and ladle over broth.
tunisian-couscous.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

lebanese-kibbeh.title: Lebanese Kibbeh
lebanese-kibbeh.description: Fried bulgur and lamb shells stuffed with spiced meat, onions and pine nuts.

ingredients.item: fine bulgur, soaked 15 minutes and squeezed
very lean ground lamb or beef, for the shell

steps: Process the bulgur, lean meat, grated onion, half the spices and salt into a smooth paste, using ice water if needed.
For the filling, brown the ground lamb with the chopped onion, pine nuts and remaining spices.
Shape a ball of shell mix, hollow it with your finger, fill and seal into an oval.
Fry at 350°F for 5 to 6 minutes until deep brown. Serve with yogurt.
lebanese-kibbeh.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

indian-baingan-bharta.title: Baingan Bharta
indian-baingan-bharta.description: Smoky fire-roasted eggplant mashed with onion, tomato and spices.
steps: Roast the eggplants over a flame or under the broiler, turning, until charred and collapsed. Peel and mash.
Fry the cumin seeds in oil, add the onion until golden, then the ginger-garlic and chile.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook until soft.
Stir in the eggplant and cook 5 minutes. Season and top with cilantro.
indian-baingan-bharta.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

indian-aloo-gobi.title: Aloo Gobi
indian-aloo-gobi.description: Potatoes and cauliflower cooked with turmeric, cumin and ginger.
steps: Fry the cumin seeds in oil, add the onion and cook until soft, then the ginger and chile.
Add the tomato and spices for 2 minutes.
Add the potatoes and cauliflower with salt, cover and cook on low 15 to 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until tender.
Sprinkle with garam masala and cilantro.
indian-aloo-gobi.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

turkish-lahmacun.title: Turkish Lahmacun
turkish-lahmacun.description: Thin, crisp flatbreads topped with spiced minced lamb, rolled up with herbs and lemon.

ingredients.item: lemon wedges, parsley and sliced onion, to serve

steps: Heat the oven with a baking stone to 500°F.
Pulse the onion, pepper, tomatoes, garlic and parsley finely, then mix with the lamb, pepper paste, spices and salt.
Roll the dough into very thin rounds and spread thinly with the topping.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Squeeze with lemon, scatter parsley and onion, and roll up to eat.
turkish-lahmacun.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

indian-rajma-chawal.title: Rajma Chawal
indian-rajma-chawal.description: Punjabi kidney bean curry in a thick onion-tomato gravy, served with rice.

ingredients.item: each coriander, cumin and chile powder

steps: Fry the cumin seeds, then cook the onion until browned and add the ginger-garlic paste.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook until the oil separates.
Add the beans and 2 cups water and simmer 25 minutes, mashing a few beans.
Stir in the garam masala and cilantro and serve over rice.
indian-rajma-chawal.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

georgian-khachapuri.title: Adjarian Khachapuri
georgian-khachapuri.description: Boat-shaped Georgian bread filled with molten cheese, topped with an egg and butter.
steps: Heat the oven to 475°F.
Divide the dough into 4 ovals. Roll the long sides in toward the middle and twist the ends to make boats.
Fill the centers with the mixed cheeses.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until golden.
Drop an egg yolk and a pat of butter into each and bake 1 to 2 minutes more. Stir together at the table and tear off the crust to dip.
georgian-khachapuri.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

filipino-kare-kare.title: Filipino Kare-Kare
filipino-kare-kare.description: Oxtail and vegetables in a rich peanut sauce, served with shrimp paste.

ingredients.item: annatto oil or 1 tsp annatto powder

steps: Simmer the oxtail in water for 2 1/2 to 3 hours until tender. Keep 4 cups of the broth.
Cook the onion and garlic, add the broth, peanut butter, ground rice and annatto and simmer until thick.
Add the oxtail, then the beans and eggplant, and cook until tender. Add the bok choy last.
Serve with rice and bagoong on the side.
filipino-kare-kare.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

indian-idli-sambar.title: Idli Sambar
indian-idli-sambar.description: Soft steamed rice cakes with tangy lentil and vegetable stew.

ingredients.item: idli batter (fermented rice and urad dal)

steps: Grease the idli molds, fill with batter and steam 10 to 12 minutes until set.
Cook the toor dal until soft and mash.
Cook the vegetables, onion and tomato in water until tender, then add the tamarind, sambar powder, dal and salt and simmer 10 minutes.
Fry the mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil and pour over the sambar.
Serve the idli with the sambar and coconut chutney.
indian-idli-sambar.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

georgian-khinkali.title: Georgian Khinkali
georgian-khinkali.description: Large twisted soup dumplings filled with spiced beef and pork in juice.

ingredients.item: salt and plenty of black pepper

steps: Knead the flour, warm water and salt into a firm dough. Rest 30 minutes.
Mix the meats, onion, herbs, spices and salt, then work in the cold water until loose.
Roll the dough and cut 4-inch circles. Add filling and gather the edge into many pleats, twisting the top into a knot.
Boil in salted water 10 to 12 minutes.
Dust with pepper. Bite a hole, sip the juice, and leave the knot.
georgian-khinkali.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

filipino-pancit.title: Filipino Pancit Bihon
filipino-pancit.description: Thin rice noodles stir-fried with chicken, shrimp and vegetables, served with calamansi.
steps: Cook the garlic and onion in the oil, then the chicken until cooked, then the shrimp.
Add the vegetables and cook 2 minutes.
Add the broth, soy sauce and oyster sauce and bring to a boil.
Add the noodles and toss until they absorb the liquid.
Serve with calamansi wedges.
filipino-pancit.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

korean-tteokbokki.title: Korean Tteokbokki
korean-tteokbokki.description: Chewy rice cakes simmered in a sweet and spicy gochujang sauce with fish cakes.
steps: Soak the rice cakes in warm water if they are hard.
Bring the broth to a boil and stir in the gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce and sugar.
Add the rice cakes and simmer 8 to 10 minutes, stirring, until soft and the sauce thickens.
Add the fish cakes, green onions and eggs and cook 3 minutes more.
korean-tteokbokki.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

sri-lankan-kottu-roti.title: Sri Lankan Kottu Roti
sri-lankan-kottu-roti.description: Chopped flatbread stir-fried on a griddle with vegetables, egg, chicken and curry sauce.

ingredients.item: paratha or roti, cut into thin strips
cooked chicken curry, shredded, with 1/2 cup sauce

steps: Fry the onion, curry leaves and chiles in the oil, then the leek, carrot and cabbage for 3 minutes.
Push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the chicken and roti strips and chop and toss everything together with two spatulas.
Add the curry sauce, season and toss until hot.
sri-lankan-kottu-roti.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

filipino-sinigang.title: Filipino Sinigang
filipino-sinigang.description: Sour tamarind soup with pork and vegetables.

ingredients.item: pork spareribs or belly, in pieces

steps: Simmer the pork, onion and tomatoes in 10 cups water for 45 minutes, skimming.
Add the tamarind mix and daikon and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the beans, eggplant and chiles and cook until tender.
Add the greens and fish sauce and serve with rice.
filipino-sinigang.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

armenian-dolma.title: Armenian Dolma
armenian-dolma.description: Grape leaves rolled around beef, rice and herbs, simmered in a lemony broth.
steps: Mix the beef, rice, onion, herbs, tomato paste and spices.
Place a leaf vein side up, add a spoon of filling, fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Pack the rolls seam side down in a pot lined with spare leaves.
Add the broth and lemon juice, weigh down with a plate and simmer 1 hour.
Serve with garlic yogurt.
armenian-dolma.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

japanese-oyakodon.title: Japanese Oyakodon
japanese-oyakodon.description: Chicken and onion simmered in sweet dashi and soy, set with egg over rice.
steps: Simmer the dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar with the onion for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook 5 minutes.
Pour the eggs over, cover and cook 1 minute until softly set.
Slide over bowls of rice and top with herbs.
japanese-oyakodon.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

korean-sundubu-jjigae.title: Korean Sundubu Jjigae
korean-sundubu-jjigae.description: Bubbling spicy soft tofu stew with seafood and an egg.
steps: Cook the pork in the oil, then add the gochugaru and garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the broth and soy sauce and bring to a boil.
Add the seafood and spoon in big pieces of tofu. Simmer 5 minutes.
Crack in the egg, add green onions and cook 1 minute. Serve bubbling with rice.
korean-sundubu-jjigae.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

indonesian-beef-rendang.title: Indonesian Beef Rendang
indonesian-beef-rendang.description: Dry, deeply spiced beef curry slow-cooked in coconut milk until caramelized.
steps: Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger, galangal, chiles, 1 lemongrass and turmeric into a paste.
Fry the paste in oil 5 minutes, add the beef and coat.
Add the coconut milk, remaining lemongrass and lime leaves and simmer uncovered 2 1/2 to 3 hours, stirring more often as it thickens.
Stir in the kerisik and sugar and cook until the sauce is dark and clings to the beef. Season with salt.
indonesian-beef-rendang.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

persian-fesenjan.title: Persian Fesenjan
persian-fesenjan.description: Chicken stewed in a rich, sweet-sour sauce of ground walnuts and pomegranate molasses.
steps: Toast the walnuts and grind very fine.
Brown the chicken and onion in the oil.
Add the walnuts and broth and simmer 30 minutes, stirring.
Add the pomegranate molasses, cinnamon, sugar and salt and simmer 45 minutes until thick and dark.
Top with pomegranate seeds and serve with rice.
persian-fesenjan.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

japanese-unagi-don.title: Japanese Unagi Don
japanese-unagi-don.description: Grilled eel glazed in sweet tare sauce over rice.
steps: Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and sake until syrupy to make the tare.
Brush the eel with tare and broil 3 to 4 minutes until bubbling.
Spoon a little tare over the rice, add the eel and drizzle with more.
Sprinkle with sansho pepper.
japanese-unagi-don.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

indonesian-gado-gado.title: Indonesian Gado-Gado
indonesian-gado-gado.description: Vegetable salad with tofu, egg and potatoes under a sweet-spicy peanut dressing.
steps: Blend the peanuts, garlic, chiles, kecap manis, lime juice and about 1 cup water into a thick sauce. Season with salt.
Arrange the vegetables, tofu and eggs on a platter.
Pour the peanut sauce over and serve with prawn crackers.
indonesian-gado-gado.note: A representative home version. Restaurants and regions make it in many ways, and this isn't any one restaurant's recipe.

japanese-soba-noodles.title: Cold Soba Noodles
